notes.title: Accessories Update is out!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

A huge new update just dropped! 

You can now merge your pets together to unlock special accessories!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309317/6eb1ab85642f49a451b8ede16666e919162090ec.png

Every GibblePET comes with its own unique accessory that can be equipped on the head, body, or hands.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309317/307caf997f016cedae386ff7dbabfe369479525d.gif
Accessories are tradeable, so you can share them with your friends!

We can’t wait to see how you customize your pets!

This update also brings two new traits:

Holo
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309317/51cc65be3ec8eb19dbdef7454982df0494e591f3.png

Golden
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309317/9c3ee768cc510ee671bfadac95217c0406978ceb.gif

Oh and yes, you can now throw your pet across the screen :D
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309317/6e5ece17a417f8faa2afa6ca1d1811212c62794f.gif

Lastly, check out the new Traitbox available on the game store page, it guarantees a pet with a trait and helps support GibblePETS!

Thank you for playing, see you next time!

-Vokayl

notes.title: QoL Update for upcoming release!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
Thanks for all the support that you're showing for the upcoming release of GibblePETS.
If you're interested in following the development of the game, make sure to follow and wishlist!

That said, I've been working on some new furniture and making sure it all fits in with the style of the game :)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309317/3313827e3ee2baf314249253c7498fd7efdc60d5.png

Like many of you requested, I've added a feature to better track item drops. Instead of adding a timer, for now I've opted to add this little icon that shows up on your windowed pet when you drop a new box!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309317/0932267a73786be5cfeb28f6682b406496f0d8c7.png

That's all for now, make sure to keep up on new updates!
